newsitem.title: FRANCE: SGS-Thomson rises in line with U.S. stocks.
newsitem.headline: SGS-Thomson rises in line with U.S. stocks.

text.p: Shares in SGS-Thomson Microelectronics NV topped the risers on the Paris Bourse on Tuesday in line with a recent recovery of U.S. semiconductor stocks and ahead of first half results on Thursday, dealers said.
At 1446 GMT, the shares were up 7.78 percent at 540 francs.

SGS-Thomson will host a news conference on Thursday afternoon in Paris after publishing its figures in the morning. On June 6, the company said that its second quarter results would be in line with the first quarter.
Jean Danjou of Societe Generale said the market was expecting "a message of improvement" of the sector in the second half.
He added that U.S. semiconductior stocks had been rising recently after the announcement of results by Motorola.
Motorola on July 9 reported a second quarter earnings per share of $0.62 while the market had expected $0.52.
